exposure.learner_inputs: Raw documents and query bytes only; task labels, properties, expected source IDs, strata and workspace expectations are evaluator/authorized-teacher metadata.
exposure.teacher_authorization: After the learner attempt, supervise all occurrences of the exact answer bytes, or STOP for absence of the requested property in the complete consistent TRAIN pool. Unexecuted candidates receive surrogate gradients, not fabricated execution failures.
exposure.growth_scope: Four unrelated documents are ingested only after teaching for updates-off interference probes; no growth targets or training replay.

documents.text: For avrek, transport is andalusite and audit records carry alpine aster. The service besin uses blue eyed grass for transport. The audit inspection of besin is scheduled for Tuesday.
The audit records of derum carry common spotted orchid. The service calvo exchanges messages using bog myrtle; its audit label is anorthite. A transport review also lists derum as a participant.

The service eskar labels audit records eastern red cedar. To exchange messages, eskar uses bur oak as its transport setting; fovin chooses apatite for transport. A review mentions the audit timetable for fovin.

The transport setting used by gelru is false goats beard. Audit records belonging to havis are marked aragonite, whereas gelru marks its own audit records candy tuft. The transport inspection list also names havis.
Messages for irven travel using giant feather grass. For audit records, irven uses the label augite. Transport for joral is set to coral bells; an audit meeting names both services.
For lesam, desert sage labels audit records. The notes assign kedru the transport value benitoite and the audit label hairy bitter cress. A separate transport checklist mentions lesam.

The transport entries list morvi with boracite and nelux with large white trillium. The audit label for morvi is evening primrose. The service nelux attends the weekly audit review together with morvi.

The service orvek uses brookite to identify audit records and fox sedge for transport between services. The audit label for pasir is lesser water plantain. A transport timetable lists both names for maintenance planning.
For qevan, transport is golden currant and audit records carry northern sea oats. The service rosil uses cerussite for transport. The audit inspection of rosil is scheduled for Tuesday.
The audit records of talun carry chromite. The service sevar exchanges messages using pale yellow iris; its audit label is heath violet. A transport review also lists talun as a participant.

The service urevi labels audit records clinozoisite. To exchange messages, urevi uses red flowering currant as its transport setting; vesor chooses indigo bush for transport. A review mentions the audit timetable for vesor.

The transport setting used by walim is cordierite. Audit records belonging to xevur are marked japanese quince, whereas walim marks its own audit records small leaved lime. The transport inspection list also names xevur.
Messages for yarvo travel using corundum. For audit records, yarvo uses the label kentucky coffeetree. Transport for zelin is set to southern wax myrtle; an audit meeting names both services.
For bovek, tall meadow rue labels audit records. The notes assign adrix the transport value lemon balm and the audit label crocoite. A separate transport checklist mentions bovek.
The transport entries list cernu with meadow cranesbill and delvi with cuprite. The audit label for cernu is western sword fern. The service delvi attends the weekly audit review together with cernu.

The service erqon uses nodding onion to identify audit records and yellow horned poppy for transport between services. The audit label for fesul is diaspore. A transport timetable lists both names for maintenance planning.

growth_documents.text: The town museum keeps an archive of transport posters. Volunteers review the paper condition during an annual audit. A faded caption describes a railway exhibition, while the catalogue records the dimensions of each display case.

Garden volunteers exchange messages about watering times. Their meeting notes separate weather observations from an equipment audit. The transport of compost is discussed on another page, along with the dates when the gates will be open.

At the lakeside station, observers record wind direction and water levels. An audit checks whether every measurement has a date. The visitor leaflet describes local transport links and the path from the bus stop to the shore.

The community theatre labels storage boxes by room number. During its safety audit, the team inspects lamps and cables. A transport notice gives the delivery timetable for scenery; it does not describe software services or their configuration.
